about: Re-simulated Friday Oct 2 (morning ET) with Wednesday and Thursday practice reports and the week's news. Steelers–Browns is final and graded; its picks stay as they were at kickoff. Players listed as out are removed and 72% of their carries and targets go to teammates at their position, split by what each has done this season. Flags mark news the model still can't price: players who might not play, and Friday game statuses that come out this afternoon.

Justin Jefferson.n: Ankle sprain, missed Wednesday and Thursday. Built with him playing at a trimmed share. He likely needs to practice Friday to play; if he sits, Jordan Addison is the No. 1.

Jordan Addison.n: Becomes the No. 1 receiver if Jefferson sits. This build has Jefferson playing.

Will Shipley.n: Foot, upgraded to limited Thursday; has a shot to play. Built with him playing.

Jalen Coker.n: Quad, upgraded to limited Thursday after missing Wednesday. Built with him playing.

Xavier Legette.n: Knee, missed Wednesday and Thursday. Built with him playing.

Keon Coleman.n: Ankle, limited Thursday after missing Wednesday. Built with him playing.

Caleb Douglas.n: Ankle, missed Wednesday and Thursday after sitting out Week 3. Built with him playing.

Colby Parkinson.n: Knee/shoulder, missed Wednesday and Thursday. Built with him playing.

Charlie Kolar.n: Forearm, missed Wednesday and Thursday. Built with him playing.

Brenen Thompson.n: Quad, missed Wednesday and Thursday. Built with him playing.

Rachaad White.n: Shoulder, missed Wednesday and Thursday in London. Built with him playing; Jacory Croskey-Merritt gets more if he sits.

Austin Ekeler.n: Signed this week and may be active if Rachaad White can't go.

Tyjae Spears.n: Ankle, limited Thursday; played through it last week. Built with him playing.

Mike Evans.n: Rib, missed Wednesday and Thursday (worked on the side). GM John Lynch says he'll make every attempt to play. Built with him playing.

Puka Nacua.n: Back after missing two games (hip/groin), limited Wednesday and Thursday. Modeled at his usual share; a snap limit would make his numbers high.

Nico Collins.n: Back after missing two games, limited Wednesday and Thursday. Modeled at his usual share; a snap limit would make his numbers high.

Kene Nwangwu.n: No offensive snaps this season. His share comes mostly from the model's running-back average, so treat his number as high. Braelon Allen is the lead back, with Isaiah Davis mixed in.

D'Andre Swift.n: New knee injury: added to the report Thursday as a DNP. Built with him playing at a trimmed share; Kyle Monangai leads the backfield if he sits.

Kyle Monangai.n: Becomes the lead back if D'Andre Swift (knee) can't go. This build has Swift playing.

Davante Adams.n: His Wednesday and Thursday DNPs were rest days, not an injury; he's expected to play and is modeled at his full share.

2026w4-mia-min-ml-min.n: Built with Jefferson playing; he missed Wednesday and Thursday. MIN stays a big favorite either way.

2026w4-mia-min-ats-min.n: Built with Jefferson playing; he missed Wednesday and Thursday. If he sits, this is weaker than shown.

2026w4-ten-bal-td-derrick-henry.n: BAL lost both centers (Gwyn, Pocic) long-term: a small knock on short-yardage runs the model can't see yet.

2026w4-la-phi-ats-phi.n: Built with Smith, Goedert and Hollywood Brown out, Shipley playing and Puka Nacua back. Eagles' final statuses come Friday afternoon.

2026w4-la-phi-ml-phi.n: Same as the PHI spread: Smith, Goedert and Hollywood Brown out, Puka Nacua back. Final statuses come Friday afternoon.

2026w4-la-phi-tot-over.n: Built with Smith, Goedert and Hollywood Brown out and Puka Nacua back. Final statuses come Friday afternoon.

2026w4-gb-tb-ats-tb.n: Built with Jalon Daniels starting. The model has this a pick'em while the market moved to GB -3.5; the model rates an unknown rookie QB only a little below average.

pit-cle: Final: Browns 27, Steelers 24 (Andre Szmyt's 56-yard field goal with 10 seconds left). Picks are frozen as they stood at kickoff and graded: 13 of 29 won. None were on the Top plays board.
The model's Under 38.5 lost (51 points) and PIT win lost; CLE +2.5 won. Warren (93 rushing yards), Metcalf, Boston, Concepcion and Fannin hit their yardage lines.
ind-was: Mariota starts again for WAS (in the model). Jayden Daniels was limited.
WAS RB Rachaad White (shoulder) missed Wednesday and Thursday; Austin Ekeler signed. S Nick Cross (in this build) and G Sam Cosmi are ruled out.
ten-bal: Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers were full participants Thursday. Flowers is in this build; the Sep 30 build had him out.
BAL lost centers Jovaughn Gwyn and Ethan Pocic long-term. TEN's Tony Pollard was full Thursday, Tyjae Spears limited.
ne-buf: DJ Moore limited (shoulder), expected to play. Keon Coleman was limited Thursday.
NE CB Christian Gonzalez and RT Morgan Moses missed Wednesday; Drake Maye was a full participant.
nyj-chi: Caleb Williams out; Case Keenum starts in this build (not officially named). D'Andre Swift (knee) was added to Thursday's report as a DNP.
NYJ without Breece Hall, Adonai Mitchell and TE Mason Taylor. Braelon Allen leads the backfield and Garrett Wilson's target share jumps to about 37%.
jax-cin: Jakobi Meyers limited (thumb) as usual. JAX RB LeQuint Allen Jr. limited (hip).
CIN S Kyle Dugger and DT B.J. Hill missed Wednesday.
dal-hou: Nico Collins is back (limited Wednesday, expected to play) and in this build. The Sep 30 build had him out.
la-phi: LA gets Puka Nacua back (limited Wed/Thu; in this build); TE Terrance Ferguson is out. Davante Adams' two DNPs were rest days.
PHI: DeVonta Smith, Goedert and Hollywood Brown are out in this build (all DNP Wed/Thu; the team doesn't expect Smith to play). Shipley was limited Thursday. Final statuses Friday afternoon.
gb-tb: Baker Mayfield (dislocated thumb) is out about three weeks; undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts. The model now has this a pick'em (TB 54% before); the market moved to GB -3.5 and the total to 38.5.
GB's Jayden Reed is out for the season (neck surgery); his targets go to Golden and Watson. Chris Godwin Jr. was a full participant Thursday.
mia-min: Justin Jefferson (ankle) missed Wednesday and Thursday; this build has him playing. Friday's practice decides it.
MIA lost De'Von Achane for the season; Ollie Gordon II leads, with Jaylen Wright (full Thursday) in a smaller role.
kc-lv: Nothing material: Mahomes and Ashton Jeanty practiced fully. Brock Bowers is no longer on the report.
lac-sea: LAC missed six on Wednesday, including CB Donte Jackson (concussion) and TE Charlie Kolar. Derwin James and Ladd McConkey were limited.
den-sf: Mike Evans (rib) missed Wednesday and Thursday but worked on the side; the GM expects him to try to play. Christian McCaffrey's Wednesday DNP was a rest day.
det-car: CAR placed CBs Jaycee Horn and Mike Jackson on IR (in this build's matchups). Jalen Coker was limited Thursday, Xavier Legette missed again; Bryce Young, Chuba Hubbard and Darren Waller were full.
atl-no: NO RB Travis Etienne is out for multiple weeks; Alvin Kamara starts. The spread moved to ATL +2.5, which this build uses.
ari-nyg: NYG RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. was limited Thursday; LT Andrew Thomas missed Wednesday.
